# AnyX

> AnyX is a universal payment adapter for the x402 protocol. It enables any token holder
> (ETH, USDT, WBTC, cbBTC, SOL, BTC via Lightning, and any ERC-20) to pay x402-gated APIs
> and services without manually acquiring USDC on Base. AnyX intercepts the HTTP 402 challenge,
> routes the payer's token through a DEX aggregator (1inch, 0x) to obtain USDC, signs an
> EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on behalf of the payer, and submits it to a standard
> x402 facilitator. API providers receive standard x402-compliant USDC payments — unchanged.
> AnyX earns a 0.05–0.75% swap spread on every non-USDC payment routed.

## What AnyX Does

- Intercepts HTTP 402 Payment Required responses from any x402-compatible API
- Reads the required USDC amount, recipient (payTo), and network from the 402 challenge
- Queries DEX aggregators (1inch Fusion+, 0x Permit2) for best swap rate: input token → USDC
- Executes the swap atomically and obtains the required USDC amount
- Signs EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization (off-chain, gasless)
- Submits the signed authorization to the x402 facilitator (Coinbase CDP or self-hosted)
- Returns the 200 OK API response with payment receipt to the caller

## API Base URL

https://api.anyx.xyz

## Authentication

Optional API key in header: X-API-Key: {your_key}

Tiers:
- Free: 100 req/min, $100/month volume cap, no subscription needed
- Pro: 1000 req/min, unlimited volume, $49/month via Stripe
- Enterprise: custom limits, SLA, self-hosted option — contact hello@anyx.xyz

## Core Endpoints

### POST /v1/quote
Get a swap quote for paying a specific x402 endpoint with your preferred token.
Always call quote before pay to get the quoteId and confirm the cost.

Request body:
{
  "endpointUrl": "https://api.example.com/data",  // URL of the x402-gated resource
  "inputToken": "ETH",                             // Token symbol to pay with
  "inputChainId": 8453,                            // Chain ID where you hold the token
  "slippageBps": 50                                // Optional: slippage tolerance in basis points (default: 50 = 0.5%)
}

Response:
{
  "quoteId": "uuid-v4",
  "inputToken": "ETH",
  "inputAmount": "0.000424",          // ETH amount to spend (includes AnyX fee)
  "inputAmountUSD": "1.002",
  "usdcRequired": "1.000",            // USDC the API will receive
  "fee": "0.002",                     // AnyX swap spread in USDC
  "feeBps": 20,                       // Fee in basis points
  "route": { "dex": "1inch", "priceImpact": "0.0008" },
  "expiresAt": "2025-08-25T12:35:00Z"  // Quote valid for 30 seconds
}

### POST /v1/pay
Execute the payment using a previously obtained quote.

Request body:
{
  "quoteId": "uuid-from-quote",
  "walletAddress": "0x..."   // Your wallet address (tokens will be pulled from here)
}

Response:
{
  "receiptId": "uuid-v4",
  "status": "settled",
  "txHash": "0x...",
  "blockNumber": 22891234,
  "inputToken": "ETH",
  "inputAmount": "0.000424",
  "usdcSettled": "1.000",
  "apiResponse": { ... },             // The original API response (200 OK body)
  "xPaymentResponse": "base64..."     // x402 settlement receipt header value
}

### GET /v1/receipt/:id
Retrieve a payment receipt by ID.

Response: Full PaymentReceipt object (same shape as /v1/pay response)

### GET /v1/tokens
List all supported input tokens with current USD prices.

Response:
{
  "tokens": [
    {
      "symbol": "ETH",
      "name": "Ethereum",
      "address": null,
      "chainId": 8453,
      "decimals": 18,
      "isNative": true,
      "usdPrice": "2365.42",
      "swapPath": "direct"
    },
    ...
  ],
  "updatedAt": "2025-08-25T12:00:00Z"
}

### POST /v1/lightning/invoice
Generate a Bitcoin Lightning invoice to pay a specific x402 endpoint.
Available in Phase 3 (October 2025+).

Request body:
{
  "endpointUrl": "https://api.example.com/data"
}

Response:
{
  "bolt11": "lnbc...",           // BOLT-11 Lightning invoice
  "paymentHash": "0x...",
  "amountSats": 1068,            // Satoshis to pay (includes AnyX fee)
  "usdcEquivalent": "1.002",
  "expiresAt": "2025-08-25T12:05:00Z"
}

### GET /v1/lightning/status/:paymentHash
Check if a Lightning invoice has been paid.

Response:
{
  "status": "pending" | "paid" | "expired",
  "settledAt": "2025-08-25T12:01:30Z",
  "receiptId": "uuid-v4"   // Set when status is 'paid'
}

## SDK (NPM Package)

Install: npm install @anyx/sdk
Or: bun add @anyx/sdk

Basic usage:
```typescript
import { UPA } from '@anyx/sdk'

const upa = new UPA({
  preferredToken: 'ETH',
  preferredChainId: 8453,        // Base mainnet
  wallet: walletClient,          // viem WalletClient
  maxSlippage: 0.005,            // 0.5% max slippage
})

// Drop-in replacement for fetch() — auto-handles 402
const res = await upa.fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
const data = await res.json()
```

Advanced usage:
```typescript
// Get quote first, then pay
const quote = await upa.quote('https://api.example.com/data')
console.log(`Will cost ${quote.inputAmount} ETH (${quote.usdcRequired} USDC)`)

const receipt = await upa.pay('https://api.example.com/data', { quoteId: quote.quoteId })
console.log(`Settled. TxHash: ${receipt.txHash}`)

// Event hooks
upa.on('payment', (receipt) => {
  console.log(`Paid ${receipt.inputAmount} ${receipt.inputToken}`)
})
```

## Supported Input Tokens (v1.0)

Chain: Base (chainId: 8453)
- ETH (native)
- USDT (ERC-20): 0xfde4C96c8593536E31F229EA8f37b2ADa2699bb2
- WETH (ERC-20): 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006
- cbBTC (ERC-20): 0xcbB7C0000aB88B473b1f5aFd9ef808440eed33Bf
- Any ERC-20 on Base (via 0x routing)

Chain: Ethereum (chainId: 1) — Phase 2
- USDT (ERC-20): 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7
- WBTC (ERC-20): 0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599
- WETH (ERC-20): 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2

Chain: Solana (chainId: 101) — Phase 2
- SOL (native)
- USDT (SPL): Es9vMFrzaCERmJfrF4H2FYD4KCoNkY11McCe8BenwNYB

Bitcoin via Lightning Network — Phase 3
- BTC (satoshis via BOLT-11 invoice)

## Fee Structure

AnyX charges a swap spread applied to the input token amount:
- USDT → USDC: 0.05% (near-zero slippage stablecoin pair)
- ETH → USDC: 0.20%
- WBTC / cbBTC → USDC: 0.25%
- Any ERC-20 → USDC: 0.20% base + actual DEX slippage
- BTC (Lightning) → USDC: 0.50%
- Cross-chain (Solana, Ethereum → Base): 0.30%

The payer's net cost is approximately equivalent to or better than a CEX conversion.
No flat fees on free tier. Pro tier: no volume cap.

## Error Reference

All errors return: { "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details": any } }

Error codes:
- QUOTE_NOT_FOUND: quoteId does not exist
- QUOTE_EXPIRED: quote older than 30 seconds; call /v1/quote again
- SWAP_FAILED: DEX aggregator failed; try a different token or retry
- SETTLEMENT_FAILED: x402 facilitator rejected the payment
- INVALID_INPUT: missing or malformed request field
- RATE_LIMITED: exceeded rate limit for your API key tier
- INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: wallet does not hold enough of inputToken
- SLIPPAGE_EXCEEDED: actual swap rate worse than slippageBps tolerance
- NO_ROUTE: no DEX route found for this token pair on this chain
- ENDPOINT_NOT_X402: the target URL did not return a 402 Payment Required

## AI Agent Integration

### LangChain
npm install @anyx/langchain

```typescript
import { AnyXPaymentTool } from '@anyx/langchain'
const tool = new AnyXPaymentTool({ wallet, preferredToken: 'ETH', preferredChainId: 8453 })
// Add to your LangChain agent's tools array
```

### Coinbase AgentKit
npm install @anyx/agentkit

```typescript
import { ANYX_PAY_ACTION } from '@anyx/agentkit'
// Add ANYX_PAY_ACTION to your AgentKit actions list
```

### MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
npx @anyx/mcp-server

Tools exposed: anyx_quote, anyx_pay, anyx_receipt, anyx_supported_tokens
Compatible with: Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP-compatible client
